description: Social plan Task 4, the photo groundwork (lane H; migration 0024_player_photos_purpose): one new column on player_photos, purpose ('gallery', 'social' or 'market'), NOT NULL with the default 'gallery', so every existing photo becomes a Gallery photo. consent_at may now be empty, for photos that are not Gallery photos only (a check keeps it required for Gallery photos). A trigger refuses any change of a photo's purpose; a unique index on display_url covers only the rows that are not Gallery photos (none exist); social_posts' index on photo_id (the table is empty) becomes a unique one. No row is added or removed and no existing value changes: every photo keeps its player, status, files, consent time and club. Additive: no row, account, email, phone, session, role or membership may change. After the run every player_photos row must have purpose = 'gallery'. Live traffic keeps writing while the migration runs, so the tables below are listed as volatile. player_photos is not among them: a photo shared during the run shows as a new row and is checked by hand.
